result_text:
The four default conventions now match the files they were meant for. The full `codeanalyzer` suite passes (334 tests, 0 failures, 3 skipped), including a new test for these rules.

Changes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and `<meta name="generator">` rules now match `(html|htm|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`.
- **.NET documentation XML:** the path pattern is `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches. The `<doc>` content check is unchanged.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by …`:** the path pattern is `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** the pattern is `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks the four fixed rules and includes negative cases: a hand-written `.htm`, a plain `settings.xml`, a plain `app.js`, and a plain `app.js` against the Gradle rule. The new test and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass.

Nothing is committed. A `sed` command was refused by the shell, so I made the edits with the file editor instead.
